entries.title: JournalEvent
entries.summary: Sealed hierarchie 6 typů událostí v append-only journalu (přejmenováno z LedgerEvent v Stage A doménového refactoru). Každá nese deterministický eventKey — re-zápis stejného eventu je no-op (set() v Firestore, composite unique v Isaru). Žije v lib/domain/journal/ a používá package:meta místo flutter/foundation, aby splnila domain purity guard.

entries.title: Journal (abstract aggregate)
entries.summary: Read-only doménová abstrakce nad ledger storage. Nahrazuje přímé volání repository query metod z application vrstvy — providers / projekce čtou přes Journal facade, append zůstává repository concern. Scaffold landl v Phase 2; konzumenti migrují inkrementálně přes strangler-fig pattern.

entries.title: PeriodKey (UTC-enforced VO)
entries.summary: Value object pro time-window klíče v Journal eventech (yyyy-MM-dd den, yyyy-Www ISO týden, lifetime, chapter:id). Konstrukce výhradně přes named factories, které normalizují DateTime na UTC. Adresuje cross-TZ collision risk z deeper auditu — dva přístroje v různých zónách na stejný UTC den teď produkují identický key.

entries.title: Progression catalog identifier hierarchy
entries.summary: Twelve extension type wrappers pro String ids — všechny v lib/domain/progression/catalog/ids.dart po R.1 (cosmetic ids.dart konsolidováno sem). Tři implementují umbrella ProgressionEntryId (QuestId, AchievementId, MilestoneId) — generic API (Journal.eventsForNode) přijímá libovolný. ChapterId, ObjectiveId, ChainId, ComboPoolId, DailyTierGroupId, CosmeticId, TitleId, EmblemId zůstávají separate namespaces (ne ProgressionEntryId siblings, jen `implements String`). R.1 přidal pět novel wrapperů (ChainId, ComboPoolId, DailyTierGroupId, TitleId, EmblemId) jako součást catalog row migration — Quest.chainId / Quest.comboPoolId / Quest.dailyTierGroupId / RewardDefinition cross-references všechno typed. Všech dvanáct `implements String` — typed wrapper IS-A String, takže typed → String passing nevyžaduje .raw cascade. Reverse směr (String → typed) blokovan kompilátorem, takže authoring sites musí explicitně konstruovat. Zero runtime overhead.

entries.title: Player (aggregate root)
entries.summary: Immutable value object aggregating per-user durable state (uid, level, totalXp, joinedAt, rpgModeEnabled, displayName, photoUrl). Single-player app — neexistuje globální Context aggregate, kompozice se děje ve widget stromu (ChangeNotifierProxyProvider2). Phase 5 přepnula source-of-truth: Player.level + Player.totalXp jsou teď computed z Journal eventů přes statickou factory Player.fromJournal(uid, rewardGrants, levelCurve, ...) — sumuje XP přes RewardGrantEvent.xpAmount kde rewardKind == xp, aplikuje LevelCurve.resolve. Stejnou factory volá i ProgressionEngineProvider.EngineProfile getter (přes Player.totalXpFromGrants), takže oba konzumenti dělí jediné canonical computation. Žádný cycle, žádný drift. joinedAt zatím pořád ze SharedPreferences cache v engine provideru — Journal-derived join lands later. Phase 6+ začnou Player number číst (lifecycles, projections); zatím je to surface API.

entries.title: PlayerQuestLifecycle (sealed)
entries.summary: Phase 6 zavedla sealed lifecycle pro Quest catalog rows: 4 podtypy (QuestLocked / QuestAvailable / QuestCompletedPendingClaim / QuestClaimed) místo bag-of-booleans (isCompleted / isAvailableForClaim / isLockedByConditions) na EngineQuestProgress. Widget consumeři pattern-matchují přes exhaustive switch — compiler vynutí pokrytí všech 4 stavů. Bridge mezi old flags a new sealed type je getter EngineQuestProgress.lifecycle; precedence (Locked > Claimed > PendingClaim > Available). R.1 dovysadila `QuestLocked.remaining: List<UnlockCondition>` payload (proposal §4.1) — engine vrací nesplněné top-level conditions přes nový `UnlockConditionResolver.unsatisfied(...)` API; `ProgressionResolutionResult.lockedNodeRemainingConditions` map je sibling `lockedNodeIds`. Sister lifecycles `AchievementLocked.remaining: List<UnlockCondition>` a `ChapterLocked.gate: UnlockCondition?` dostaly stejné R.1 wiring; multi-condition gates u kapitoly wrap v `AllOf`.

entries.title: PlayerQuest (read projection unit)
entries.summary: Phase 7 immutable value object binding a [Quest] catalog row, a sealed PlayerQuestLifecycle, a DateTime evaluatedAt. Projection unit of PlayerQuestCatalog. R.1 promoted the previous narrower `id: QuestId` field to the full `quest: Quest` catalog reference (proposal §2.4) — Quest now lives in lib/domain/progression/catalog/ alongside PlayerQuest, so the purity-guard rationale that originally forced the id-only shape is gone. A forwarded `QuestId get id => QuestId(quest.id.value)` keeps Phase 7 call sites (PlayerQuestCatalog.byId(QuestId)) compiling without a sweep. Equality keys on `quest.id` plus lifecycle + evaluatedAt so two PlayerQuests with the same catalog id but distinct row instances compare equal — matches the Phase 7 cache-invalidation semantic.

entries.title: PlayerQuestCatalog (read projection collection)
entries.summary: Phase 7 read projection: Map<QuestId, PlayerQuest> wrapped immutably (entries jsou Map.unmodifiable). Konzumenty: ProgressionEngineProvider.playerQuestCatalog getter (lazy cache klíčovaná identityHashCode(_ledger) + _devDayOffset), screen filter expressions. Accessors: byId / all / length / isEmpty / contains; lifecycle filters locked / available / pendingClaim / claimed; bucket slice among(ids); ad-hoc where(predicate). PlayerQuestCatalog.empty sentinel pro pre-first-evaluation state — screen consumeři čtou bez null guard. Insertion-order preserving. Phase 8 (PlayerAchievementShelf) + Phase 13 (ChapterLifecycle) build na stejném vzoru.

entries.title: PlayerAchievementLifecycle (sealed, 3 stavy)
entries.summary: Phase 8 sealed lifecycle pro Achievement catalog rows. 3 podtypy: AchievementLocked / AchievementInProgress (actual, target) / AchievementUnlocked (finalXp, unlockedAt). Žádný PendingClaim stav — V2 achievementy mají ClaimPolicy.automatic per proposal §4.2, takže přechod InProgress → Unlocked je atomický v rámci jednoho eval cycle. Bridge mezi old EngineAchievementView flags (unlocked / isLockedByConditions) a new sealed type je getter EngineAchievementView.lifecycle (mirror Phase 6 EngineQuestProgress.lifecycle). Precedence: Unlocked > Locked > InProgress — JINÁ než quest precedence (Locked > Claimed > PendingClaim > Available) protože achievementy se nikdy nere-lockují (idempotent completion event). Pinned 4-row mapping table v test/features/progression_engine/engine_achievement_view_lifecycle_test.dart. AchievementLocked.remaining payload (proposal §4.2 navrhuje List<UnlockCondition>) je v Phase 8 prázdný — UnlockCondition pořád žije v lib/features/, plný condition slice landne až s catalog rename.

entries.title: PlayerAchievement (read projection unit)

Stejný QuestId-keyed deferral pattern jako PlayerQuest — proposal §2.4 chce { Achievement achievement; ... }, ale Achievement pořád žije v features/ a domain ho nemůže importovat. Application/presentation konzumenti resolvují plný catalog row přes ProgressionEntryCatalog.definitionForId(...).

entries.title: PlayerAchievementShelf (read projection collection)
entries.summary: Phase 8 read projection: Map<AchievementId, PlayerAchievement> wrapped immutably. Konzumenty: ProgressionEngineProvider.playerAchievementShelf getter (lazy cache (identityHashCode(_ledger), _devDayOffset)). Accessors: byId / all / length / isEmpty / contains; lifecycle filters locked / inProgress / unlocked + unlockedCount; bucket slice among(ids); ad-hoc where(predicate). PlayerAchievementShelf.empty sentinel. "Shelf" namespace per proposal §2.4 — achievementy se ukazují v gridu, ne queue jako quests. Phase 8 service bere primitives (catalog + completed/locked sets + objective lookups + XP scaler), ne EngineAchievementView, protože view nese AppLocalizations dependency kterou provider nemá. Decoupled cleanly: shelf = lifecycle state, view = lifecycle state + display data.

entries.title: Companion (catalog row — canonical companion data)
entries.summary: Companion subtype of the sealed Cosmetic hierarchy is the single source of truth for every companion definition in the app — display (name, description, asset, rarity, region) AND unlock gate (levelGate, requiredItems) AND buffs (CompanionBuff, FoodTriggerReward). The companion-catalog consolidation (2026-05-21) added the gate fields directly to the row so the three feature-side consumers — Companion catalog inventory display, CompanionAvailability progression node, CosmeticUnlockRule grant pipeline — all read from this one place: companions_content.dart filters catalog.companions by levelGate != null and maps to CompanionAvailability; cosmetic_unlock_rules.dart does the same and maps to CosmeticUnlockRule. Engine UI's titleKey / descriptionKey closures ARE Companion.name / Companion.description — no per-companion l10n switch table any more. Before consolidation, the same level + relic + rarity tuple was hand-authored three times and drifted twice (commit 6cac3d4). Companions with levelGate == null (today only DevTools-granted Monster Energy) are absent from both derivations by construction. CosmeticUnlockRule.sourceId is null for compound rules (the (cosmeticId, sourceType) pair is already 1:1 with the rule — a separate source reference would just rename the cosmeticId).

entries.title: PlayerCosmeticLifecycle (4 stavy) + Inventory
entries.summary: Phase 10 sealed lifecycle pro per-player cosmetic stav: CosmeticHidden / CosmeticTeased(satisfied, total, rows) / CosmeticClaimable(claimVia) / CosmeticOwned(unlockedAt, source, sourceId). Mapping z předchozích paralelních enumů: CosmeticRevealState.hidden → CosmeticHidden, .visibleLocked → CosmeticTeased(progress=0), .partial → CosmeticTeased(hasProgress=true), .unlocked → CosmeticOwned. Companion-specific Claimable přidává čtvrtý stav (engine availableNodeIds.contains(id)). Identity-hide pravidlo pro companions není state, ale derivace přes top-level hidesIdentity(Cosmetic, PlayerCosmeticLifecycle) helper per proposal §4.3. Inventory aggregate = Map<CosmeticId, PlayerCosmetic> read projection vystavený přes CosmeticsProvider.buildInventory(claimableNodeIds). Phase 11 smazala paralelní CompanionState enum + CompanionsRegistry factory — UI nyní pattern-matchuje výhradně na (Cosmetic catalog, PlayerCosmeticLifecycle). Zbylá companion-specific lookup (availability node pro claim flow + devtools matrix) žije v companion_availability_lookup.dart jako pure top-level funkce.

entries.title: ChapterLifecycle + PlayerChapterProgress + Chapter catalog wrapper
entries.summary: Phase 13 sealed lifecycle pro chapter stav (proposal §4.4): ChapterLocked / ChapterUnlockedNotStarted(unlockedAt) / ChapterInProgress(currentChainNodeId, stepsCompleted, stepsTotal) / ChapterCompleted(completedAt). Stejný read-projection pattern jako Phase 7 PlayerQuestCatalog + Phase 8 PlayerAchievementShelf — PlayerChapter VO drží ChapterId reference + lifecycle; PlayerChapterProgress collection wrapuje immutable Map<ChapterId, PlayerChapter>. Chapter catalog wrapper (lib/domain/progression/catalog/chapter.dart) agreguje chain entries (opener / steps / finale / optional completion / side-quests) přes id-only references — žádný cross-feature import potřeba. ChapterCatalogBuilder + PlayerChapterProgressService žijí v lib/features/progression_engine/application/ a building bere primitives (completedNodeIds + lockedNodeIds + earliestCompletionAt closure). Phase 13 zároveň smazala lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/node_state.dart — NodeState enum přesunutý do resolveru jako internal state-machine vocabulary (.name strings keep engine consumer working).

entries.title: EmblemBoard (11-slot profile showcase)
entries.summary: Phase 12 relokace ze social/ do cosmetics/ + extrakce VO. Per-user 11-slotový grid (4+4+3 layout) na profile header. Distinct od `Loadout.emblemId` — board je **public showcase** (collection view), Loadout.emblemId je single **worn** emblem broadcastovaný přátelům. Imutabilní; `withPin(slot, id)` + `autoFillWith(unlockOrder)` pro state mutations. Persistence per-device v SharedPreferences `pinned_emblems_{uid}` (comma-joined wire format zachován z legacy PinnedEmblemsStore — devices roll forward bez migrace). Owned by `EmblemBoardProvider` v cosmetics/application/. Social/ už nevlastní cosmetic-collection state.

entries.title: Result<T, E> + AppError sealed (typed cross-boundary errors)
entries.summary: Phase 18 ships foundation pro typed cross-boundary error handling. **Result<T, E>** sealed (lib/core/result/result.dart) = Success(value) / Failure(error). Helpers map / flatMap / unwrapOr + isSuccess / isFailure predicates pro pattern matching ergonomics. **AppError** sealed hierarchy (lib/core/errors/app_error.dart) s 5 subtypes: NetworkError(isTransient default true, statusCode, endpoint) — Firestore offline / KT 401 / HC quota; ValidationError(reason) — domain invariant violations, always permanent; PermissionError(scope) — HC permission denied / Firestore rule rejection, permanent; NotFoundError(entityType, id) — entity miss, permanent; UpstreamError(context, isTransient default true) — catch-all unknown. Každý AppError nese originalError + stackTrace pro preservation + `label` getter pro AppLog payload. **Firebase classifier** (lib/core/errors/firebase_error_classifier.dart) mapuje FirebaseException.code → typed subtype: unavailable/deadline-exceeded/cancelled/internal/aborted/resource-exhausted → NetworkError(transient); permission-denied/unauthenticated → PermissionError; not-found → NotFoundError; invalid-argument/failed-precondition/out-of-range/already-exists → ValidationError; unknown → UpstreamError. **KT classifier** (lib/core/errors/kt_error_classifier.dart): KtAuthException → NetworkError(401, transient) triggers re-login retry; KtApiException → UpstreamError(transient); ClientException → NetworkError; other → UpstreamError. **Consumer wiring:** HybridProgressionEngineRepository pull/push/wipe wrapnuté přes classifyFirebaseError + Result-based decision. Plus pullEventsClassified() public method exposes Result<LedgerSnapshot, AppError> pro consumers co chtějí pattern-matchovat. BackgroundSyncService.backgroundSyncCallback classifies caught exception via _classifyBackgroundSyncError (KT → KT classifier, Firebase → Firebase classifier, ostatní → UpstreamError) a vrací `error.isTransient` jako WorkManager retry decision (replace previous unconditional 'return true' that hid permanent failures). Permanent failures logged at error level (visible v DevTools / crash reports); transient at warn. Scope tightly scoped: domain repository interface migrations to Result<T,E> deferred jako future PR — Phase 18 ships foundation + outermost data layer audit fix (DoD 'zero untyped swallows in sync codepath').

entries.title: SocialPresence aggregate + per-entity files + SocialPresenceRepository
entries.summary: Phase 17 split monolithic social_models.dart do per-entity files (handle.dart / friend_request.dart / friendship.dart / achievement_share.dart / social_notification.dart / social_user_profile.dart) + zachoval social_models.dart jako barrel re-export (12+ presentation imports beze změny). Nový SocialPresence immutable aggregate facade bundling uid + ownProfile + incomingRequests + outgoingRequests + friendships + friends + recentShares + notifications + derived unreadNotificationCount / hasPendingIncomingRequests. SocialPresence.anonymous sentinel pro pre-sign-in. SocialProvider.presence getter fabricates aggregate z existujících internal lists (incrementální migration path — widgets můžou postupně přejít z socialProvider.friendships na socialProvider.presence.friendships). ownProfile zatím null protože provider nedrží own published profile snapshot lokálně (jen ho píše přes publishProfile); future hydration via watchProfilesByIds([_activeUid]). SocialRepository → SocialPresenceRepository mechanical rename per proposal §2 (aligns s PlayerRepository / InventoryRepository / JournalRepository naming). Zachován @Deprecated typedef SocialRepository = SocialPresenceRepository pro backward compat (žádný call site break). Firestore wire format frozen — Phase 17 explicitly nemění persistence semantics, jen Dart-layer rename + facade extraction. SocialUserProfile + SocialUserStats docstrings explicit označují je jako 'Cache, not source of truth' + popisují rebuild path z Player + Loadout + Journal (Phase 20 JournalProjection promote to first-class projection contract).

entries.title: ProfileStatCatalog + statVisibilityOverrides (profile stats visibility model)
entries.summary: Per-user stat visibility model landl 2026-05-25. SocialUserProfile dostal nové Set<String> statVisibilityOverrides (blacklist) — owner-toggled per-stat opt-outs. SocialUserStats wire format rozšířen o nullable personal metrics: stepsLifetime / stepsAvg30d / activeDays30d (activity), avgSleepMinutes7d / avgBedtimeMinutes7d / avgWakeMinutes7d / avgDeepMinutes7d / avgRemMinutes7d (sleep), latestWeightKg / latestBodyFatPct (body), avgKcal7d / avgProteinG7d / avgFatG7d / avgCarbsG7d (nutrition). Projection (SocialProfileProjection._buildPersonalMetrics) tahá hodnoty z volitelně bound FitnessProvider + KalorickeTabulkyProvider — když source unbound, wire fields zůstanou null a friend devices renderují '—'. ProfileStatCatalog enumeruje stat klíče přes ProfileStatDescriptor { key, category, defaultHidden, ownerOnly } — defaultHidden:true u sensitive (body, nutrition, granted rewards, cosmetics unlocked, sleep) znamená opt-in publishing; ownerOnly:true u cosmetics-count (wire format ho nenese). Sedm kategorií: hero, streaks (single-key card-level visibility 'streaks.allRecords'), activity, sleep, body, nutrition, social. Resolver isStatVisibleForViewer({key, statVisibilityOverrides, isOwner}) je gating logika: owner vidí všechno; foreigner viz catalog-default → blacklist trump. updateHiddenStatKeys repo metoda (separate od upsertProfile) píše jen single-field merge — vizibilita je user input, projection rebuild ji nesmí přepsat (ADR profile-stats-visibility). ProfileStatsSection (UI) je StatefulWidget s edit-mode togglem v hlavičce, per-row eye toggles, kurátorovaný default. Inline subsumes the HeroStreakStatsCard přes 'streaks.allRecords' card-level key.

entries.title: EngineEvaluationContext + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides (engine arg bundle)
entries.summary: Phase 16 nahradil flat `EngineEvaluationInput` record strukturovanými VO bundling 8 typed inputs co engine konzumuje: Player + HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot + GoalBoard + Journal + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides + evaluatedAt. LedgerCounters (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/ledger_counters.dart) drží journal-derived aggregations (totalRewardCount, rewardCountByRule, bestStreakByDomain, bestRollingStepsByDays, nodeCompletionCounts, comboPoolCompletionCounts, totalQuestCompletions, questCompletionsByBucket, distinctActiveDays, nodesCompletedToday) — provider-side derivation logic v ProgressionEngineProvider._buildLedgerCounters() (Phase 20 JournalProjection později přesune derivation do Journal). EvaluationOverrides (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/evaluation_overrides.dart) drží runtime provider-state overrides (dnes jen objectiveActualOverrides pro chapter-step baselines). EngineEvaluationContext slouží jako internal helper bundle pro sub-evaluators (ObjectiveEvaluator, ProgressionNodeResolver, UnlockConditionResolver, RewardGrantPlanner přijímají ho jako single arg). Public ProgressionEngine.evaluate() signature je structured named args (player, healthSnapshot, nutritionSnapshot, goalBoard, journal, counters, overrides, evaluatedAt) per migration plan §Phase 16 — no flat record between provider and evaluator. Internally engine.evaluate() builds context once a passes dolů přes _evaluateWithContext(). Plus claim() + simulateClaim() + simulateObjectiveMet() všechny mají identický 8-arg signature shape. Journal interface dostal in-memory adapter (lib/domain/journal/in_memory_journal.dart) wrapping List<JournalEvent>; engine zatím internally reads ledger via repository.loadLedger() (strangler-fig per follow_ups.md §2.13). ProgressionResolutionResult.inputSnapshot → contextSnapshot field rename. Side-by-side test verification: stejné ObjectiveCompletionEvent / NodeCompletionEvent / RewardGrantEvent emise pro identical seed inputs pre vs post-refactor.

entries.title: GoalBoard + PlayerGoal (per-Player goals with revision history)
entries.summary: Phase 14 extrakce per-Player goalů z GoalsProvider mixed-state do domain layeru. GoalMetric enum (9 metrik: dailySteps / targetWeight / dailyCalories / dailyProtein / dailyFat / dailyCarbs / dailyFiber / sleepHours / weeklyActivityMins) + GoalRevision VO (effectiveFrom date-only + value) + PlayerGoal entity (metric + current target + List<GoalRevision> history). GoalBoard collection wrapuje Map<GoalMetric, PlayerGoal>. Persistence beze změny — SharedPreferences keys `goal_<metric>` (scalar target) + `goal_<metric>_history` (JSON revision list) match the pre-extraction wire format byte-for-byte; targetWeight nemá historii (single current value). PlayerGoal.resolveForDate(day) vrací target effective on day pro retroactive backfill evaluation (latest revision <= day, fallback to history.first). PlayerGoal.ensureRevisionAt(anchor, currentValue) je no-op když resolution už matchne — používáno init() pro fixup stale future-dated revisions. GoalBoard.progressionHistorySignature vylučuje targetWeight a slouží jako cache-invalidation pro ProgressionProvider.signature. GoalsProvider zůstává jako thin façade (ChangeNotifier + SharedPreferences I/O); všechny existující gettery (`.dailySteps`, `.dailyCalories`, ...) + setters + `progression*ForDate(day)` API delegují na board — žádný consumer není breaking.

entries.title: JournalProjection<T> + RebuildFromJournalReason (cache rebuild contract)
entries.summary: Phase 20 promotes the ad-hoc cosmetic-unlock replay pattern into a first-class JournalProjection<T> abstract interface s typed `RebuildFromJournalReason` enum (factoryReset / pullAndMerge / devToolsWipe / periodicResync). The codebase má dvě denormalised caches that this contract now covers: (1) **CosmeticUnlockBridge** (implements JournalProjection<int>) replays RewardGrantEvent grants into CosmeticsProvider inventory after pull-and-merge / factory reset — rebuildFromJournal returns the count of cosmetics actually unlocked (idempotent: a second call returns 0). (2) **SocialProfileProjection** (implements JournalProjection<SocialProfileSyncPayload?>) builds the Firestore profile cache row from Player + Loadout + Journal — same payload the previous inline _buildSyncPayload in SocialProvider produced (wire format frozen per Phase 17). SocialProvider drží projection instance + delegates _syncProfileIfNeeded přes _profileProjection.buildPayload(); the JournalProjection.rebuildFromJournal hook delegates to publishIfReady() so future explicit 'republish my profile from scratch' affordance lands without restructuring. Engine pull-and-merge call site (_pullCloudLedger v progression_engine_provider) volá `_cosmeticBridge.rebuildFromJournal(events: merged.all, reason: RebuildFromJournalReason.pullAndMerge)` namísto pre-Phase-20 `reapplyHistoricalCosmetics(LedgerSnapshot)`. Idempotency invariant tested directly v test/features/progression_engine/cosmetic_unlock_bridge_projection_test.dart (factory reset → 0 applied; pull-and-merge → 2 applied; second pull-and-merge → 0 applied).

entries.title: EmblemBuff (sealed)
entries.summary: Sealed hierarchie buffů nasaditelných na `Emblem` katalog entry. `Emblem.buff` je nullable — emblem buď přidává mechanický bonus, nebo zůstává čistě dekorativní. Dvě varianty: `PerTargetEmblemBuff` (matches jediný `EmblemTarget`) a `BlanketEmblemBuff` (matches every target, který je covered alespoň jedním per-target buffem v katalogu). `int resolvePercent(EmblemBuffContext)` vrací 0..100 — 0 znamená 'tento buff se na tento claim neaplikuje'. Equipped buffy collectuje engine přes `EmblemBoardProvider.boardForUserOrAutoFill(uid, unlockedIds)` (NE z owned set — equipped = buffed); RewardGrantService sumuje jejich percenty s companion% additively (`final = base × (1 + (companion% + emblem%) / 100)`), žádný per-day cap. RPG mode off → engine předá `const []` → žádný emblem bonus.

entries.title: EmblemTarget (sealed granularity carrier)
entries.summary: Sealed VO identifying *co* buff cílí. Vznikl protože `RewardSourceKind` byl moc hrubozrnný (`nutritionXp` lumpuje všech pět macro goalů dohromady) — `GoalMetric` má správnou resoluci. Dvě varianty: `DailyGoalTarget(GoalMetric metric)` pro denní cíle (kalorie / kroky / makra / spánek / aktivita / váha) a `ComboQuestTarget()` pro combo-bucket questy. Mapping z `ProgressionEntry` (quest node) na target dělá `emblemTargetForNode` (lib/features/progression_engine/application/emblem_target_mapping.dart) — string switch nad node.id pro daily-section nodes, fallback na ComboQuestTarget pro combo questy, jinak null. Vrácený null znamená, že žádný emblem dnes ten node necílí — i blanket buff respektuje toto (přes `BlanketEmblemBuff.covers`). **Drobnost (2026-05-21):** `DailyGoalTarget(GoalMetric.targetWeight)` se renderuje v inventáři jako "denní zápis váhy" (NE jako "Cílová váha", což je název nastavení v Settings) — `_metricLabel` v `emblem_buff_label.dart` má tento case napojený na ARB klíč `emblemBuffWeightLogTarget`, aby player-facing copy pojmenovala XP-bearing event místo Settings vstupu.

entries.title: PerTargetEmblemBuff
entries.summary: Konkrétní `EmblemBuff` co matchne jediný `EmblemTarget`. `resolvePercent(ctx)` vrací `percent` když `ctx.target == target`, jinak 0. V1 katalog ships deset takových buffů, každý +10 % (devět denních cílů + combo questy). Equality nad EmblemTarget je value-based (DailyGoalTarget compares metric, ComboQuestTarget je singleton), takže `const PerTargetEmblemBuff(target: DailyGoalTarget(GoalMetric.dailySteps), percent: 10)` matchne jakýkoli claim na `daily_steps_today` node.

Generace 2..N suffixují `@<gen>` k `nodeId`, `chainId` a `objectiveId` — gen 2 chain 1 step 1 je `combo_balanced_step_1@2`, jeho chainId `combo_balanced@2`, jeho objectiveId `combo_balanced_step_1_obj@2`. `templateIdOf(nodeId)` strips suffix; `withGenerationSuffix(template, gen)` ho aplikuje (gen 1 = no-op pro back-compat). Evaluator's `LifetimeCompletionsAmongMetric` matchuje completions přes template, takže triple_combo achievementy rolují přes všechny generace bez znalosti suffixu.
